name: wan_hybrid_attention_b1_s4800_h40_d128_bf16
description: Wan video serving attention (flashinfer PR #4543 'wan_hybrid' backend): dense non-causal attention over contiguous NHD bf16 q/k/v at the fixed B1/S4800/H40/D128 serving contract. The target kernel keeps QK^T in bf16 and runs the P.V stage with NVFP4 probabilities and two-level NVFP4 values; the contract is the bf16 attention it approximates.

seq_len.description: Query and key/value length (61x448x832 latent grid).
